name: Convert URL Filter
description: A text-format filter that rewrites absolute links pointing at internal (own/configured) hosts into relative URLs on output.
project_description: Convert URL Filter provides a single text-format filter plugin (id convert_url_filter) that rewrites absolute anchor hrefs pointing at internal hosts into root-relative paths when content is rendered. The current site host (from the incoming request) is always treated as internal, and additional bare domain names can be configured per text format (one per line, no scheme or www prefix). It parses the filtered HTML with DOMDocument (via Html::load), inspects each <a href> element, and strips the scheme/userinfo/www/host/port prefix from matching links, leaving the path. It is a display-time transform: stored content is unchanged and no new links are created from plain text. Typical uses are domain migrations, keeping links portable across environments, and avoiding hard-coded domains in body content.
